candidates: When code in Storybook's Next.js framework packages (e.g., under code/frameworks/nextjs/ or code/frameworks/nextjs-vite/) needs to import Next.js functionality — including in mock/export files and routing providers — use the public Next.js package entrypoints (e.g., 'next/headers', 'next/navigation', 'next/router') rather than internal next/dist/* paths. The next/dist/* paths are undocumented implementation details with no stability guarantees; they can change or disappear across Next.js versions, causing module-resolution failures at build time.
